filters.advancedDescription: Set secondary position and adjustment-history filters. The list refreshes from the server with the active filter set.

columnDescriptions.account: This column shows the account that owns the balance row.
columnDescriptions.asset: This column shows the asset held by the account.
columnDescriptions.available: This column shows the immediately available balance.
columnDescriptions.held: This column shows the balance currently reserved by pending activity.
columnDescriptions.incoming: This column shows incoming balance that has not settled into availability yet.
columnDescriptions.avgEntryPrice: This column shows the average entry price stored for the balance.
columnDescriptions.realizedPnl: This column shows realized profit and loss recorded for the balance.
columnDescriptions.updated: This column shows when the balance row was last updated.
columnDescriptions.adjust: This column contains the row action for opening a position adjustment.

empty.title: No balances
empty.hint: Use Adjust to seed spot-funds balances for an account and asset.

panel.title: Adjustment
panel.descriptionExisting: Compare the current position with the intended values before submitting.
panel.descriptionDraft: Set the account, asset, intended values, and optional bounds before submitting.
panel.boundsOptional: Optional bounds for the submitted adjustment.
panel.noChangesError: Enter at least one amount, average price, or bound.

columnDescriptions.time: This column shows when the adjustment request was recorded.
columnDescriptions.account: This column shows the account targeted by the adjustment.
columnDescriptions.asset: This column shows the asset targeted by the adjustment.
columnDescriptions.source: This column shows whether the adjustment came from the panel, REST, MCP, or another source.
columnDescriptions.request: This column shows the requested balance, held, incoming, or average-price change.
columnDescriptions.status: This column shows whether the adjustment was accepted or rejected.
columnDescriptions.outcome: This column shows the stored result or rejection summary.
columnDescriptions.externalId: This column shows the immutable adjustment ID.

empty.title: No adjustments
empty.hint: Adjustment records appear here after each submit.

dialog.title: Adjust position
dialog.description: Seed or update spot-funds balances for an account and asset. Use absolute mode to set a specific value, delta to add or subtract.

fields.avgEntryPriceHint: Positive decimal. Leave blank to keep the current value.
